properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 14 at 5:16AM EDT until August 15 at 2:46AM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Indiana...

Wildcat Creek at Kokomo.

Wildcat Creek near Jerome.

...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Indiana...

Wildcat Creek near Lafayette.

.Recent periods of heavy rainfall have led to minor flooding along
the Wildcat Creek near Kokomo, Jerome, and Lafayette. Flooding will
persist over the weekend in some locations.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wildcat Creek at Kokomo.

* WHEN...Until just after midnight tonight.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, Wildcat Creek overflowing in parks in the
Kokomo area.  Flooding of agricultural land possible outside of
Kokomo.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 4:00 AM EDT Friday the stage was 12.6 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours
ending at 4:00 AM EDT Friday was 13.4 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
this evening and continue falling and remain below flood
stage.
- Flood stage is 10.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive
cars through flooded areas.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

To escape rising water, take the shortest path to higher ground.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

EDT.
